name: deepscientist-lite
description: Independent teaching-first research workflow plugin for Codex with file-led research maps, artifacts, and a transactional Graph v2 state kernel.

interface.shortDescription: Run a lightweight DeepScientist-style research workflow inside Codex.
interface.longDescription: DeepScientist Lite is an independent, unofficial plugin inspired by the DeepScientist research workflow. It provides Codex skills, templates, and a transactional local state graph without the DeepScientist daemon, Web/TUI, connectors, MCP servers, or local model deployment. It is not sponsored, certified, or endorsed by ResearAI.
defaultPrompt: $ds-lite-intake start a research project from this question
$ds-lite-scout audit the literature and baseline route
$ds-lite-experiment record this experiment in the research map
